subject: Are we still on track for the Sept pilot approval?

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot window

Hi Maya / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can lock a pilot start: 

What we agreed on (summary)
- Scope: 3-week pilot, ingesting last 6 months of customer support transcripts (~1,000 active users) for intent extraction + response-suggest.
- Success metrics: 15–20% reduction in average handle time on test queue; >85% accuracy on intent classification for top 10 intents.
- Technical needs: S3 access for transcript export, a lightweight webhook for scored suggestions, and one person from your SRE team for the initial key exchange.

Proposed commercial / timeline
- Ballpark pilot cost: $6k–$8k for the 3-week run (includes model compute + SRE support).
- Target pilot start: week of Sept 7 (we can be flexible to Sept 13 if procurement needs a few extra days).
- Approval ask from LedgerStack: confirmation on budget owner and explicit sign-off by EOD Sept 3 if you want the Sept 7 start.

Next steps / asks for you
1) Can you confirm the budget owner and whether the budget sits in Q3?
2) If Sept 7 works, I’ll send an SOW and a short PO template for procurement — attaching the draft SOW and the current pricing sheet.
3) If priorities shifted, tell me and we’ll re-run dates.

Attachments: RSI_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF), LedgerStack_Pricing_Sheet_v2.xlsx (XLSX)

Happy to hop on a 15-min call tomorrow to iron out procurement questions.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Maya / Tom — quick check-in.

Following up on my note from Aug 30 — haven't seen confirmation yet on the budget owner or a go/no-go for a Sept pilot start. If priorities shifted this quarter, no problem — just tell me and I’ll adjust the timeline.

If you’re still aiming for a Sept test, can we do one of the following to move it along?
- A 15-min call today to confirm procurement contact and sign-off timeline, or
- You can reply with the budget owner + confirm whether procurement needs a PO or a contract redline.

I can also slide the pilot to Sept 13–20 if that helps procurement close the loop.

Thanks — short replies totally fine.

Best,
Jordan
